title: Tennis | Calm Joints
description: A short tennis kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist.
sub: Tennis asks a lot of shoulders, elbows, knees and feet: serves, wide steps, long matches. Here’s a short kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist if you’d like to talk through how you move.
